features.description: Remove the anonymous POST /api/main/save-user endpoint (created users with an unhashed password, bypassing registration) and related code: controller/service methods, SaveUserInput/SaveUserResponse/WSSaveUserPayload schemas, frontend api.saveUser; update docs and requirements. Issue 65 in docs/plan/code-issues-found-during-docs.md

features.name: Shared Rate-Limit Counter
features.description: Redis-backed rate-limit store so HTTP L1, per-route and WS upgrade limits are shared across instances (leftover of item 2 / finding C-2). Today the counter lives in process memory; the nginx edge limit in documentation/backend/deployment.md is the workaround. Details: docs/plan/code-issues-found-during-docs.md item 2, docs/plan/ws-upgrade-rate-limit-plan.md; plan: docs/plan/redis-rate-limit-plan.md; tasks: docs/plan/redis-rate-limit-tasks.md

features.name: Strip Console Logs In Production
features.description: Frontend production build must not print to the browser console: remove console.log(data) with wsToken from App.vue and strip console.log/info/debug/trace via esbuild.pure in the app and service-worker builds (code-issues item 60)
features.evidence: This PR: pnpm --filter frontend build (dist: console.log 45 -> 0, info 4 -> 0, debug 1 -> 0; warn/error kept), dev server keeps logs, frontend tests 41, typecheck, lint, docs:build + docs:verify

features.name: Backend Console To Pino
features.description: Route runtime console.error calls in the backend through pino (WS close handler, server stop); malformed JSON bodies become MalformedBodyError -> 400 bad_request logged as warn without the body (previously 500 + logger.error to Sentry with a parser message that can quote the body); drop console.log("start")
features.evidence: This PR: backend tests 471 (new malformed-body.spec.ts), typecheck, lint, docs:build + docs:verify

features.name: Redis Main Client Fast Failure
features.description: Main Redis client fails fast instead of hanging ~45 s when Redis is down: no offline queue or resend, commandTimeout, RedisUnavailableError -> 503 service_unavailable with Retry-After, one Sentry event per incident (redis-health), WS heartbeat independent of Redis, logoutAll deadline (code-issues item 70). Plan: docs/plan/redis-main-client-timeout-plan.md; tasks: docs/plan/redis-main-client-timeout-tasks.md
features.evidence: PR #37 (merged 17ea622): typecheck, lint, backend 551, frontend 45, test:redis 31 (incl. logoutAll retry and password-reset regressions), docs:build + docs:verify, manual check with two backends and Redis stopped 19 s; evidence in progress.md on feat/redis-main-client-timeout.
